# FreeFermion_Topological_Classification

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A theoretical method for classifying topological phases in free-fermion systems under measurement-induced dynamics, extending topological invariants to open quantum systems. Provides a rigorous foundation for understanding how measurement and decoherence affect topological order, critical for fault-tolerant topological computing.
